annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI)
key_provisions_or_claims: Strategy published in the Diário Oficial da União on 9 April 2021
Aims to contribute to ethical principles for responsible AI development and use
Promotes sustained R&D investment and removal of barriers to innovation
Covers workforce training and public-private-research cooperation
Built from expert survey and public consultation with about 1,000 contributions
annotation.summary_en: Government news item from Brazil's Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation announcing the publication of the Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Strategy (EBIA) in the Official Gazette on 9 April 2021. It outlines the strategy's objectives: ethical AI principles, R&D investment, innovation, workforce training and cooperation. It does not reproduce the strategy text.
annotation.title_clean: Estratégia Brasileira de Inteligência Artificial é publicada no DOU
annotation.title_en: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Strategy is published in the Official Gazette
